newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint closes firmer against dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint closes firmer against dlr.

text.p: 1240 GMT - The Hungarian forint followed the dollar/mark cross on Friday, closing slightly firmer against the dollar at 175.78/83 in very light trade, dealers said.
The forint, which floats against a basket of currencies made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar, opened at 175.90/176.00 against the U.S. unit.
Dealers said the forint was keeping its 50 filler gap from the central bank resistance level, suggesting no new domestic factors affected trade. (Full report to follow)
